claude.sample_unit: hospitalized patients with T2DM (development); 3,191 health-screening individuals in external cohort

links.outcome: Discrimination and calibration of carotid plaque model in independent external cohort versus development test set
links.effect: Test-set AUC 0.827 (95% CI 0.791-0.862) fell to 0.666 in the external cohort of 3,191 screening individuals, with marked miscalibration; 33.4% specificity at 85% sensitivity.
links.quote: In the external cohort, the AUC was 0.666 with marked miscalibration; updating left discrimination unchanged, and at 85% sensitivity, specificity was 33.4%.

links.outcome: Whether updating/recalibrating the model on local data improved discrimination in the external cohort
links.effect: Updating assessed by split-half validation left discrimination unchanged (AUC 0.666) despite marked miscalibration; specificity 33.4% at 85% sensitivity.
links.quote: In the external cohort, the AUC was 0.666 with marked miscalibration; updating left discrimination unchanged, and at 85% sensitivity, specificity was 33.4%.

links.effect: External AUC was 0.666 with marked miscalibration; at 85% sensitivity, specificity was 33.4%.

links.effect: Test-set AUC was 0.827 versus 0.804 for random forest and 0.816 for XGBoost.
links.quote: The test-set AUC was 0.827 (95% CI 0.791-0.862), versus 0.804 for random forest and 0.816 for XGBoost (P = 0.023 versus random forest).
